t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Different Gnomes lead you to different forests and different coloured baskets. The orange, green, red blue gnomes lead to one. The other colours will lead to the other. There is a correlation between the colour of the gnomes and the amount of mushrooms you will find in the forest.

vb_textbox.text:
On each screen you will see a pair of gnomes in front of houses. The first set of gnomes are coloured red, blue, orange and green. If you click on these it will lead you to a forest with a red basket.
The other set of gnomes are coloured brown, yellow, purple and pink. These gnomes will lead you to a forest with a yellow basket. 
The aim is to find as many mushrooms in the baskets as possible. The amount of mushrooms you find may, or may not be linked to the groups of coloured gnomes you click on.
